_comment: Copy to allowlist.local.json and replace the ASNs. That file is untracked:
which networks you administer from is a fact about you, not about the tool.
The numbers below are from RFC 5398 and are reserved for documentation.
They announce nothing, so the script will refuse to build from this file.
Source real ASNs from a per-country eyeball ranking rather than memory, and
confirm each holder before trusting it: allocations change hands and stale
notes outlive them. Rankings order by residential users, so a network you
only use during the working day may not appear at all and must be added by
Keep the set small. Two or three ASNs is a tighter control than a whole
country and costs a fraction of the firewall's entry budget.
